name: AEO buyer series — category claim
objective: Own the purchasing-criteria conversation for AEO software. Be the page cited when a buyer asks how to evaluate this category.
image_note: Prefer the URL. Two of these are queued for replacement and a URL pull picks the corrected file up without a second commit.
hard_constraints: Every post carries its URL in the BODY. The autoposter has no comment API, so there is no other placement. Write copy that carries a link naturally; never defer it with 'more below' or a trailing hook.
No cost or expense figure, ever. Prices belong on the pricing page; what anything costs us belongs nowhere a customer reads.
No invented numbers. Use ONLY the figures in verified_facts below. Not even as a labelled example.
Never claim other tools 'only give you a score' or that 'no other AEO tool measures whether AI is telling the truth about you'. Both retired as indefensible.
Never name an individual in connection with the entity-misattribution finding.
Never publish a prospect's measured numbers. Those are outreach material.
Disclose that we make one of these tools whenever a post touches the comparison.

On schema, structured data and JSON-LD: the crawlers fetch the HTML and the block is in it, so never claim otherwise. The only supported claim is that most platforms show no sign of USING it when choosing what to cite. Use that wording.

verified_facts.category_win_zero: On unbranded category questions in our September 2026 measurement, engines recommended us in 0 of 200 recorded answers.
verified_facts.branded_retrievability: Branded retrievability 100% across four engines, N=23, in the 21 September 2026 sweep.
verified_facts.llms_txt: llms.txt went unrequested on 97% of the sites that have one.
verified_facts.schema_read: In a controlled test, six of seven AI platforms showed no sign of using the page's schema when choosing what to cite; a fact placed only in schema was answered by none.
verified_facts.extractor_window: An AI sees roughly the first 200 characters after the h1; the meta description is ignored.
verified_facts.roundup_mechanism: Every category answer in our 21 September sweep was assembled from 'best tools' roundup pages. Not one came from a vendor's own product page.
verified_facts.ahrefs: Ahrefs found brand mentions correlated with AI mentions at rho 0.664, against 0.218 for backlinks.
verified_facts.princeton: The Princeton GEO study (arXiv:2311.09735) associated adding statistics with roughly a 41% citation-visibility lift.
verified_facts.engines: Four engines with web search on: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini.

stories.positioning: The asset, not the ad. This is the piece most likely to be forwarded, cited and taken into a meeting. Authority comes from publishing a standard that works against us, not from claiming one.
